columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Persistent thread queues need stable identity, explicit pause semantics, and deterministic dispatch
columns.title_zh: 持久 Thread Queue 需要稳定身份、显式暂停语义与确定性派发
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260814-G-001 with Skill 02 score 46/50. It presents the strongest bounded Digital Employee mechanism in the run-date pool: queued user work has durable IDs, explicit CRUD/reorder/start controls, change notifications, automatic FIFO dispatch after terminal turns, and a deliberate pause after interruption. This creates a concrete responsibility-runtime question about how a digital employee should retain pending work, expose operator control, resume deterministically, and avoid silently continuing after an interruption. It narrowly outranks the Remote Control recovery signal because it combines durable work identity with dispatch policy rather than recovery alone.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260814-G-001，Skill 02 评分 46/50。它是运行日信号池中最强的有界数字员工机制：排队用户工作具有持久 ID、显式增删改排与启动控制、变更通知、Turn 终态后的自动 FIFO 派发，并在中断后有意保持暂停。这形成一个具体的职责—运行时问题：数字员工如何保留待办工作、暴露操作者控制、确定性恢复，并避免在中断后静默继续执行。它以很小优势高于 Remote Control 恢复信号，因为它同时提供持久工作身份与派发策略，而不仅是恢复机制。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify queue persistence scope, stable item identity, CRUD/reorder/start semantics, notification behavior, the exact terminal states that trigger FIFO dispatch, interruption pause behavior, restart/reload persistence, and tests. Separate demonstrated Codex app-server behavior from broader digital-employee scheduling claims.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查队列持久化范围、稳定 Item Identity、增删改排与启动语义、通知行为、触发 FIFO 派发的确切终态、中断后的暂停行为、重启/重载持久性以及测试；必须把已证明的 Codex App Server 行为与更广泛的数字员工调度主张分开。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Accountable-AI operating architecture must connect governance controls to front-stage and back-stage responsibilities
columns.title_zh: 可问责 AI 运营架构必须把治理控制连接到前后台职责
columns.source_zh: Zenodo 当日一手研究产物
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260814-R-001 with Skill 02 score 38/50. It is the only run-date primary research object whose primary column is Industry Architecture and it poses a bounded architecture question: how accountable AI, trusted data, enterprise-system integration, KPI governance and operational resilience are connected across front-stage and back-stage airline functions. Selection reflects architectural relevance and novelty, not independent validation; the artifact must be read for its design-science method, evidence basis and external-validity limits before any broader conclusion.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260814-R-001，Skill 02 评分 38/50。它是运行日唯一以行业架构为主栏目的当日一手研究对象，并形成有界架构问题：可问责 AI、可信数据、企业系统集成、KPI 治理与运营韧性如何连接航空前台与后台职能。选择基于架构相关性与新信息，不代表独立验证；后续必须核查其设计科学方法、证据基础与外部有效性边界，才能形成更广泛判断。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the artifact's design-science method, architecture components and interfaces, front-stage/back-stage responsibility mapping, accountability mechanisms, data and KPI assumptions, empirical or case evidence, claimed resilience effects, and explicit limitations. Do not treat Zenodo publication, framework completeness or author claims as independent proof of effectiveness.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查该产物的设计科学方法、架构组件与接口、前后台职责映射、问责机制、数据与 KPI 假设、实证或案例证据、所声称的韧性效果以及明确局限；不得把 Zenodo 发布、框架完整性或作者主张当作独立有效性证明。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Cancellation-safe agent runtimes need request-level rollback boundaries, not partial-turn cleanup
columns.title_zh: 可安全取消的 Agent Runtime 需要请求级回滚边界，而不是局部 Turn 清理
columns.source_zh: Google Gemini CLI 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260814-G-010 with Skill 02 score 45/50. It is the highest-scoring bounded Open-source Engineering object: cancellation and abort now roll back the entire multi-turn request instead of leaving partial request state. The mechanism is concrete, regression-testable and directly relevant to agent-runtime state integrity, recovery and observability. The operation-scoped sandbox/proxy snapshot signal is also strong, but this object has a cleaner transactional boundary and a more specific failure model for today's engineering slot.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260814-G-010，Skill 02 评分 45/50。它是开源工程栏目中评分最高且边界清晰的对象：取消与中止现在回滚整个多 Turn 请求，而不是留下部分请求状态。该机制具体、可回归测试，并直接关联 Agent Runtime 的状态完整性、恢复与可观测。按操作快照 Sandbox/Proxy 状态的信号同样较强，但本对象具有更清晰的事务边界和更具体的失败模型，更适合作为今天的工程研究槽位。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the exact request state included in rollback, cancellation versus abort entry paths, rollback ordering, persistence and history effects, tool or external side-effect boundaries, nested/multi-turn behavior, and regression tests. Do not generalize request rollback into exactly-once guarantees for external effects unless the implementation proves them.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查回滚覆盖的确切 Request State、Cancel 与 Abort 的进入路径、回滚顺序、对持久化与历史记录的影响、工具或外部副作用边界、嵌套/多 Turn 行为以及回归测试；除非实现明确证明，不得把请求回滚泛化为外部副作用的 Exactly-once 保证。
